title: The algebra of global functions of a proper scheme over a field and its connected components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a proper scheme X over a field k, the eight-part lemma describes A = H^0(X, O_X): it is finite dimensional, a product of local Artinian k-algebras indexed by the connected components of X, a product of finite field extensions in the reduced case, a product of finite separable extensions in the geometrically reduced case, and A = k in the geometrically reduced and geometrically connected (or geometrically integral) cases, with the two irreducibility statements in between (statement lines 1932-1951). The proof pairs each part with one mechanism: finiteness from the finiteness of cohomology of a proper scheme over an affine base; the idempotent correspondence between product decompositions of A and decompositions of X, using that X is Noetherian so its connected components are open; reducedness to force the local factors to be fields; flat base change to the algebraic closure plus the separability criterion for finite extensions; and, in the last part, a counting argument with k_1 tensor k-bar being a product of [k_1 : k] copies of k-bar (proof lines 1953-2004). The claim is H2: eight parts, each settled by one standard input applied in the right way, with the idempotent correspondence as the only part that is not a one-line citation.
